reviewed_rules.finding: The guide covers companies listed on mainland exchanges; it does not classify ETFs as corporate industries. Other-use classification can refer to it but is not mandatory.
Sections use one letter, divisions two digits and groups three digits. Manufacturing also has a two-letter auxiliary subclass. These are different levels, not interchangeable code strings.

Classification uses disclosed audited financial business information and specified revenue/gross-profit rules, with expert determinations for unresolved cases. This review does not independently reconstruct issuer financial classifications.

The semiannual work starts June 10 and December 20, adjusted for holidays. Listings on or after the work-start cutoff can be deferred to the next classification period. An omitted recent listing is therefore not automatically a broken table or a delisting.

The review process can be postponed; the website publishes results semiannually. Published output includes sections, divisions and manufacturing subclasses. Work-start dates, nominal periods and actual availability must remain distinct.
The guide states an effective date of 2023-05-01.
